lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran paramesur chi(n)taa ganat mitaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam kot lakh baahaa ||
lines.translation: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas keeratan sa(n)g dhan taahaa ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: giaan khaRag kar kirapaa deenaa doot maare kar dhaaee he ||9||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attacked and killed the demons. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa jaap japahu jap japane ||
lines.translation: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeet aavahu vasahu ghar apane ||
lines.translation: Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh narak na dekhahu rasak rasak gun gaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d udhaaranahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch athaah aga(n)m apaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare prabh apanee so jan tisahi dhiaaee he ||11||
lines.translation: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan toR leee prabh mole ||
lines.translation: God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੇ ਘਰ ਗੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa keene ghar gole ||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: anahad run jhunakaar sahaj dhun saachee kaar kamaaee he ||12||
lines.translation: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs acts of true service. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man parateet banee prabh teree ||
lines.translation: O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: binas gaee haumai mat meree ||
lines.translation: My egotistical intellect has been driven out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai jag mahi sobh suhaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar japahu jagadeesai ||
lines.translation: Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaaee prabh apune eesai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na deesai ekaa jagat sabaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sat sat prabh jaataa ||
lines.translation: True, True, True is God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man raataa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeevahi jan tere eka(n)kaar samaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa preetam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhai udhaaran khasam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: simar naam pu(n)nee sabh ichhaa jan naanak paij rakhaaee he ||16||1||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)gee jogee naar lapataanee ||
lines.translation: The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahee ra(n)g ras maanee ||
lines.translation: She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kirat sa(n)jogee bhae ikatraa karate bhog bilaasaa he ||1||
lines.translation: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurable play. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo pir karai s dhan tat maanai ||
lines.translation: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੰਗਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir dhanahi seegaar rakhai sa(n)gaanai ||
lines.translation: The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mil ekatr vasahi din raatee priu de dhanahi dilaasaa he ||2||
lines.translation: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan maagai priu bahu bidh dhaavai ||
lines.translation: When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਆਣਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo paavai so aan dikhaavai ||
lines.translation: Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek vasat kau pahuch na saakai dhan rahatee bhookh piaasaa he ||3||
lines.translation: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan karai binau dooo kar jorai ||
lines.translation: With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pri parades na jaahu vasahu ghar morai ||
lines.translation: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa banaj karahu grih bheetar jit utarai bhookh piaasaa he ||4||
lines.translation: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved." ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagale karam dharam jug saadhaa ||
lines.translation: All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har ras sukh til nahee laadhaa ||
lines.translation: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bhaee kripaa naanak satasa(n)ge tau dhan pir ana(n)d ulaasaa he ||5||
lines.translation: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5||
